title: Minkov's double-double earns Final Four MVP as Vidabasket complete historic Bulgarian BBL double
description: Vidabasket capped a season for the ages on Sunday, demolishing Haskovo 97-78 in the BBL National Finals title game to complete the domestic double adding the national championship to the BBL Cup they won earlier in the campaign. The Vidin-based club were utterly dominant in the biggest game of their season, never giving Haskovo a sniff as they pulled away for a comfortable 19-point victory. Final Four MVP Damyan Minkov (197-F-2002) was the driving force once again with a double-double of 24 points and 11 rebounds, continuing the form that carried Vidabasket through the entire campaign.
imageCaption: Vidabasket complete historic Bulgarian BBL title (Photo: instagram)

title: Lokomotiv Plovdiv celebrate BBL Division A title
description: Haskovo - Lokomotiv Pl. 89-97 Lokomotiv Pl. players were unselfish on offense dishing 23 assists. It was a great evening for forward Hristo Bachkov (200-2004, agency: BIG) who led his team to a victory with a double-double by scoring 23 points, 18 rebounds and 4 assists. The former international center Krastan Krastanov (205-1999, agency: BIG) helped adding 21 points and 6 rebounds. The best for the losing side was guard Dinko Hristov (185-2001) with 26 points and 9 rebounds and Georgi Burzakov (-1994) produced a double-double by scoring 16 points, 5 rebounds and 11 assists. Both teams had four players each who scored in double figures. Both coaches used bench players and allowed the starting five to rest.
imageCaption: Lokomotiv Plovdiv celebrate BBL Division A title-Jun 10, 2025

title: Hebar celebrate BBL Division A title
description: Minyor 2 - Hebar 82-85 Hebar clinched the BBL Division A title. They outscored Minyor 2 in the Final to lift the trophy. Damyan Minkov (197-F-2002) was named the MVP. He finished with 27 points and 13 rebounds to pace the winners. The teams traded leads throughout the game. But Hebar went on a strong rally in the final quarter to snatch the victory. Hristo Bachkov (200-SF-2004) produced 19 points and 14 boards for the winning side. Georgi Georgi Burzakov answered with 17 points for Minyor 2.
imageCaption: Hebar celebrate BBL Division A title

title: Minyor 2015 claim BBL Division A title
description: Minyor 2015 outrebounded Haskovo 44-24 including 29 on the defensive glass. They looked well-organized offensively handing out 26 assists. It was a great evening for forward Georgi Barzakov (204-1994) who led his team to a victory scoring 30 points and 6 assists. Swingman Hristo Gatev (188-1985) helped adding 10 points and 8 rebounds. Four Minyor 2015 players scored in double figures. The best for the losing side was swingman Ivaylo Tonev (198-1999) with 26 points, 6 rebounds, 5 assists and 4 blocks and guard Dinko Hristov (185-2001) scored 21 points and 5 rebounds.
imageCaption: Minyor 2015 claim BBL Division A title (Photo: Minyor 2015)

title: CSKA clinch BBL Division A title
description: CSKA Sofia - Shumen II 79:62 CSKA clinched BBL Division A title in Bulgaria. They edged Shumen II 79:62. Trailing 21-22 at the end of the first period, CSKA Sofia posted a 14-8 run in the second frame. Moreover, they took control in the second half and nailed two more victories. Dimitar Genov (194-SG-2002) stepped up with 23 points and Asen Popov (210-C-1997, agency: Interperformances) produced 12. Viktor Gergov (200-F/G-2003) and Vladimir Nankinski (197-SF-2004) ended up with 10 points each in a win. Viktor Serafimov (190-G/F-2000) poured in 24 points in the losing effort.
imageCaption: CSKA clinch BBL Division A title (Photo: bgbasket.com)

title: Lokomotiv 2020 conquer Division A title
description: FINALLokomotiv 2020 - NSA 75-65 Lokomotiv 2020 overcame NSA to conquer Division A title. Lokomotiv 2020 forced 23 NSA turnovers. The former international forward Stanislav Slaveykov (198-86) stepped up with a double-double by scoring 29 points and 12 rebounds for the winners and swingman Samuel Francis (192-92, college: St.Joseph, IN) chipped in 17 points and 7 rebounds. At the losing side center Dragomir Enchev (206-98) responded with 9 points and 12 rebounds and guard Martin Petrov (182-1) scored 14 points and 4 assists. Four NSA players scored in double figures.
imageCaption: Lokomotiv 2020 conquer Division A title (Photo: bgbasket.com)
